minAppVersion.description: The oldest mobile app version this server still supports. Mobile clients older than this should show a blocking update-required screen.

appStoreUrl.description: This deployment's configured iOS App Store listing URL, or null if the admin explicitly cleared it. Defaults to the official pre-built iOS app when never configured.

playStoreUrl.description: This deployment's configured Google Play listing URL, or null if the admin explicitly cleared it. Defaults to the official pre-built Android app when never configured.

readOnly.description: Whether the server is running in read-only/demo mode. When true, clients can browse but cannot post, comment, upload, or make other modifications.

allOf.description: Per-family branding, set once per server by the admin. The palette is derived server-side (one implementation for every client): the brand color is darkened if needed so white text on `primary` meets WCAG AA, and a semantic post-type color (circle, milestone, trip) moves to an alternate hue when the brand would be hard to tell apart from it.

name.description: The family's name, or null to keep "Famlin".

logoUrl.description: Server-relative path of the logo, see `GET /branding/{file}`.

faviconUrl.description: Server-relative path of the 64 px favicon rendition.

loginBgFrom.description: Login background gradient start (equal to `loginBgTo` = flat).

semantic.description: Post-type colors, possibly shifted away from the brand hue. Hex colors.

hash.description: Changes whenever anything above changes — a cheap way for clients to detect a new brand.

allOf.title: Branding

branding.description: The family's branding (name, logo, derived palette), or null when the server is unbranded — clients then keep the default Famlin look. Absent on servers that predate branding; treat that like null.
